rationale: A third party (neighbor's child) suffered a bodily injury (broken wrist) on the policyholder's property due to a hazardous condition (icy walkway), which is a clear liability claim.
claim_summary: Neighbor's nine-year-old daughter suffered a broken wrist after slipping on ice on the policyholder's front walkway during last week's ice storm. Parents are pursuing medical bills. Claim is a clear third-party bodily injury liability matter with serious pediatric injury requiring prompt attention.

case_facts.location: walkway in front of policyholder's house
case_facts.description: child slipped and fell on icy walkway during ice storm
